Class TestDataFactory

@IsTest
public class TestDataFactory

Factory class for generating test data used in unit tests, primarily for BlazeBite and Firestore integrations. Provides fluent builder-style API for creating SObject records with default values and customization options. Includes specialized classes for common objects and test suites for complex multi-object scenarios.

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    04/03/2021

Version:
    1.39


Change Log

  • 04/03/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 04/25/2021 - v1.1 - Class for creating leads.
  • 05/31/2021 - v1.2 - Class for creating FirebaseAuthentication__c. Methods to standardize creation of random data.
  • 06/20/2021 - v1.3 - Class for creating Bill__c.
  • 06/21/2021 - v1.4 - Classes for creating cases, email messages and users.
  • 07/08/2021 - v1.5 - Classes for creating adjustments, invoices, invoice line items, products, and supporting docs.
  • 07/11/2021 - v1.6 - Class for creating StripeTransaction__c.
  • 07/17/2021 - v1.7 - Processing fee is populated with a random value for Payment2__c.
  • 07/18/2021 - v1.8 - Class for creating Collection__c. Support for generating payment adjustments.
  • 08/22/2021 - v1.9 - Mercury access token added to BlazeBiteSettings__c.
  • 08/24/2021 - v1.10 - Class for creating BankAccount__c.
  • 09/11/2021 - v1.11 - Method createXReferences() moved from class TestData to TestDataFactory.
  • 05/22/2022 - v1.12 - New methods to retrieve accounts and contacts created in the @TestSetup method.
  • 07/10/2022 - v1.13 - TestPayment2 now sets the field VenueId__c.
  • 02/24/2023 - v1.14 - Methods to define or create account in TestAccount. Class for creating ProductType__c.
  • 03/29/2023 - v1.15 - TestBill now calculates the service fees.
  • 10/20/2023 - v1.16 - Classes for creating commission payments and bill payments.
  • 11/10/2023 - v1.17 - TestUser: New methods to set profile and role by name or ID.
  • 11/10/2023 - v1.18 - Classes for creating Contract and ContractSignee__c records.
  • 11/19/2023 - v1.19 - TestAccount.setTag(): Method to set account tag for retrieval with getTestAccount().
  • 12/30/2023 - v1.20 - New methods to retrieve users created in the @TestSetup method.
  • 03/03/2024 - v1.21 - Open Exchange Rates access token added to BlazeBiteSettings__c.
  • 03/05/2024 - v1.22 - Accounts saved with default USD for CurrencyIsoCode__c. TestOrder2 uses account currency.
  • 03/08/2024 - v1.23 - Add Stripe service fees for international transactions.
  • 03/09/2024 - v1.24 - Method to create the custom settings DatedConversionRatesSettings__c record.
  • 08/26/2024 - v1.25 - Account Portal status is now set to Active.
  • 12/29/2024 - v1.26 - Set contacts with Standard record type by default.
  • 05/20/2025 - v1.27 - Update to API version 63.0. Change default bank account.
  • 08/15/2025 - v1.28 - TestSObject.setRecordType() and setRecordTypeId() methods added.
  • 08/15/2025 - v1.29 - Use setRecordType() in TestAccount, TestContact, TestInvoice. Update to API v64.0.
  • 08/18/2025 - v1.30 - TestInvoice: Set ExternalId__c. TestProduct2: Set StripeProductId__c.
  • 08/18/2025 - v1.31 - Class for creating Subscription__c.
  • 09/10/2025 - v1.32 - Updated to use UUID.randomUUID(). Define correct fields for each adjustment type.
  • 10/05/2025 - v1.33 - Define limit for adjustment amounts to be encoded.
  • 10/25/2025 - v1.34 - TestSObject supports Schema.SObjectField. New fields for TestStripeTransaction. API v65.0.
  • 12/20/2025 - v1.35 - Added TestBillSuite class for creating complex bill test scenarios.
  • 12/28/2025 - v1.36 - TestSuite.setFieldValue(): Configures a single field value override for a specific object type.
  • 02/27/2026 - v1.37 - Update API version to 66.0. Added getTestBill method to retrieve a test bill by partial external reference.
  • 03/19/2026 - v1.38 - Set value for Gemini_ApiKey__c when defining BlazeBiteSettings__c. Define default product record type as CustomerProduct.
  • 05/09/2026 - v1.39 - Add support for Link bank account. TestUser.setProfile(): Make sure Guest profiles do not have a role.
